Something that gets my baby to sleep, finally!. My son was born in April, but spent 2.5 months in NICU due to prematurity. He came home at the beginning of July, and although we do have central, we only use it in extreme heat to save money. My fussy baby became accustomed to falling asleep to the sound of a fan in the room. But when the cooler Fall arrived we removed the fan, and he became a terrible. I finally figured out what was different, and considered buying a white noise machine, but in researching them online I came across this app, and it’s been working wonderfully.

Simply amazing!!!. I am really picky with noise apps because I have found that the majority of them aren't offering high quality audio frequencies so I went ahead and did some reaserch for my sisters 👼🏼. Ended up using a spectrum analizer and was impressed to find that the sounds were accurate and quality was pristine, this is extremely important because the frequencies activate specific parts of the brain. I recommend you doing some reaserch on the noise colors topic and I can assure you won't be dissapointed with the app. When it comes to my newphew I always go for the best and hope you too!
